Properties.Name: txtFilterName
Properties.ControlTipText: Enter part of the provider name

VbaCode:
CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
' ============================================================================
'  Replaces sfrmProviderList with lstProviderList.
'
'    lstProviderList
'      ColumnCount    = 6
'      ColumnWidths   = "0;3120;1320;1560;720;720"    ' first col (PK) hidden
'      ColumnHeads    = True
'      BoundColumn    = 1
'      RowSourceType  = "Table/Query"
'      Tied to: frmProviderDetail
' ============================================================================
Private Enum StatusEnum
    STATUS_ALL = -1
    STATUS_ACTIVE = 1
    STATUS_INACTIVE = 2
End Enum
Private Sub PopulateProviderList(Optional whereClauseSql As String = "")
    Dim baseSql As String
    baseSql = _
        "SELECT ProviderID AS ID, " & _
               "ProviderName AS [Provider Name], " & _
               "Phone, " & _
               "City, " & _
               "StateCode AS State, " & _
               "IsActive AS Active " & _
        "FROM tblProviders " & whereClauseSql
    Me.lstProviderList.RowSource = basListHelpers.BuildAddableRowSource( _
        dataSelect:=baseSql, _
        addLabel:="(Add new provider...)", _
        dataColCount:=6, _
        orderBy:="2")          ' by Provider Name
    Me.lstProviderList.Requery
End Sub
Private Sub lstProviderList_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
    basListHelpers.OpenDetailFromList Me.lstProviderList, "frmProviderDetail"
End Sub
Private Sub btnAddNew_Click()
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProviderDetail", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
    Me.lstProviderList.Requery
End Sub
Private Sub cboFilterState_AfterUpdate()
    PopulateFilterCity
    cboFilterCity = "(All)"
End Sub
Private Sub ResetFilters()
    Me.txtFilterName = Null
    cboFilterState = "(All)"
    cboFilterCity = "(All)"
    cboFilterStatus = StatusEnum.STATUS_ALL
    btnSearch_Click
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Activate()
    PopulateFilterState
    PopulateFilterCity
    PopulateFilterStatus
    ResetFilters
End Sub
Private Sub PopulateFilterStatus()
    Dim dict As Scripting.Dictionary
    Set dict = New Scripting.Dictionary
    dict.Add STATUS_INACTIVE, "Inactive"
    dict.Add STATUS_ACTIVE, "Active"
    Me.cboFilterStatus.RowSource = basUtilities.GetFilterRowSourceFromDict(dict)
End Sub
Private Sub PopulateFilterState()
    Dim strSQL As String
    strSQL = "SELECT s.StateCode, s.StateName " & _
        "FROM tlkpStates AS s " & _
        "WHERE EXISTS " & _
            "(SELECT 'X' " & _
                "FROM tblProviders AS p " & _
                "WHERE s.StateCode = p.StateCode) " & _
        "ORDER BY s.StateName"
    Me.cboFilterState.RowSource = basUtilities.GetFilterRowSourceFromSqlSelect(strSQL)
End Sub
Private Sub PopulateFilterCity()
    Dim strSQL As String
    strSQL = "SELECT DISTINCT p.City  " & _
        "FROM tblProviders AS p "
    If Not IsNull(Me.cboFilterState) And Me.cboFilterState <> "(All)" Then
        strSQL = strSQL & _
            " WHERE p.StateCode = '" & Me.cboFilterState & "'"
    End If
    strSQL = strSQL & " ORDER BY p.City"
    Me.cboFilterCity.RowSource = basUtilities.GetFilterRowSourceFromSqlSelect(strSQL)
End Sub
Private Sub btnSearch_Click()
    Dim where() As String
    Dim i As Integer
    i = -1
    If Not IsNull(Me.txtFilterName) And Me.txtFilterName <> "" Then
        i = i + 1
        ReDim Preserve where(i)
        where(i) = "ProviderName LIKE '*" & Me.txtFilterName & "*'"
    End If
    If Not IsNull(Me.cboFilterState) And Me.cboFilterState <> "(All)" Then
        i = i + 1
        ReDim Preserve where(i)
        where(i) = "StateCode = '" & Me.cboFilterState & "'"
    End If
    If Not IsNull(Me.cboFilterCity) And Me.cboFilterCity <> "(All)" Then
        i = i + 1
        ReDim Preserve where(i)
        where(i) = "City = '" & Me.cboFilterCity & "'"
    End If
    If Not IsNull(Me.cboFilterStatus) And Me.cboFilterStatus <> StatusEnum.STATUS_ALL Then
        i = i + 1
        ReDim Preserve where(i)
        Select Case Me.cboFilterStatus
            Case StatusEnum.STATUS_ACTIVE
                where(i) = "IsActive=True"
            Case StatusEnum.STATUS_INACTIVE
                where(i) = "IsActive=False"
        End Select
    End If
    PopulateProviderList basUtilities.whereClause(where)
End Sub
Private Sub btnClear_Click()
    ResetFilters
End Sub
